notes: Cross-host workflow: Mac threads from the box, a quiet Mac bridge with a load guard, one project row for both hosts, thread resources with clean-up, account removals that propagate, deploy drift, two-way memory sync, branch travel, threads that survive a restart, pause that reaches the Mac, deploy and publish from the app, skills parity, failure cards, open on the Mac, the device row and fleet switches. Speed: a windowed transcript, a split bundle, the launch mirror, warm connections, build once deploy twice and a tiered gate. Workflow: project preambles, optional review before merge, quota-aware routing, thread notes, cross-host search, plans that start their own build, and Plan for Project
